rule: ADR 0002 is the prose source of truth for Slice 1 decisions. Planning files 10, 11, and 12 are the inputs. If a locked decision and a planning proposal disagree, the ADR wins. This file encodes those decisions. It does not add bands, stamp fields, reading identifiers, or geographies. Display genres and lot_area_m2 stay in deferred.

relation.measured_against: The concept's anchor term: the ledger row marked as the anchor in its notes, or the first same row.

tokens.meaning: The same job, and the wording is identical or a trivial variant.
Different words, same job.
Close or overlapping. Never silently equated in a calculation.
The word or appearance suggests one concept and the substance is another. The row's joining concept id is the job it actually does.
A single-tier or lower-tier municipality, or a US city, town, or village.
Upper-tier or county-level government, or a watershed or conservation authority.
A province or state government, or an agency of one.
A federal government.
A register spanning both countries under one schema and body. In the closed set. No v1 source read for this slice used it.

notes: Attach the scale to the authority of the assertion, not the host portal.
County does not decide the scale. Single-tier Ontario counties are municipal. New York counties are regional.
OSM has no scale. Leave the field absent.
Federal claims use this scale on the band they already belong to. The ladder stays six bands.

tokens.meaning: The claim attaches to a parcel.
The claim attaches to a building footprint.
The claim attaches to an address.
The claim attaches to a premises or facility record.
An overlay or zone that attaches to a unit by point_in_polygon, containment, or overlap. A line or a point needs a stated distance or side rule.
Counts for a whole county or city. Cannot attach to a spine unit.

notes: Wider than spine-key grain. Spine grain remains parcel, footprint, and address in pcdp.vocab.json.
The enum is closed here. Placing claim_grain on a fixture claim waits on the deferred stamp meta.

tokens.meaning: A local employment survey. Anchor: Niagara NEI.
A local business directory. Anchor: Welland.
A licence register. Anchor: Hamilton licence tables.
A regulatory facility registry. Anchors: TRI, NPRI, DEC. This token is not a ladder band.
A cross-program regulatory key. Anchor: EPA FRS.

notes: Facet of premises_register_key. Two register families can share the concept and still share no key.

tokens.meaning: Read live from a public source for the synonym ledger.
Repo-doc evidence or a closed product, not re-read live.
Known from a catalog entry and not read. Kept in the closed set. The v1 ledger has no such row.
Not read. Kept in the closed set. The v1 ledger has no such row.

notes: Provenance values for the synonym ledger column evidence_level. They are not evidence grades.

rules.statement: A joining concept names the job a field does. The claim keeps the publisher's field name and value. The concept id is an extra handle.
Shared concept id means the same job. It does not mean the tables join.
Federal data is stamped claims under the existing six bands, plus authority_scale. There is no seventh band and no federal group on the parcel table.
jurisdiction_activity_aggregate does not attach to a spine unit. Parcel-level refusal for that object is not_in_coverage.
planning_policy_overlay feeds the constraints band. Each claim is named by its authority.
The locked id is premises_register_key. establishment_register_key is an alias for that id.

alias_index.note: Working name from the NIA-10 extension comment. Morgen locked premises_register_key on 2026-09-25.

families.source_label: Family C — Land use and assessment

concepts.definition: The key under which a parcel appears on a jurisdiction's assessment roll or tax map.
A publisher's GIS-side identifier for a parcel polygon, used to join that publisher's own parcel, land-use, and zoning layers.
The code of the assessing municipality that accompanies a roll key.
The municipality named as text on a record. Not a key.
notes: Map the text onto the spine jurisdiction slug. Do not mint the slug from the label.

concepts.definition: A government statistical-geography code carried on a record, used to attach census-style aggregates to a jurisdiction. Not a parcel or facility key.
notes: Jurisdiction-level context. It does not make a parcel claim.

concepts.definition: Street address text or split parts for a unit.
notes: Join method, when a join is claimed, is normalized_address.

concepts.definition: Lot, concession, plan, or lot-township-range text describing a parcel legally.
A publisher's record-type or lifecycle flag on a parcel-fabric row.
notes: A fabric flag is not a property class and not a use. Brant PARCELCLASS is the false friend of New York PROP_CLASS.

concepts.definition: System row identifiers such as OBJECTID, GlobalID, FID, and NEI GSmartID. Excluded from joins so they are not mistaken for keys.
notes: Catalogued so system ids are not treated as assessment roll keys, parcel GIS keys, or premises register keys.

concepts.definition: A publisher's stable key for one premises-level record in an activity register: a local employment survey, a business directory or licence register, or a regulatory facility registry.
notes: Morgen locked this id on 2026-09-25. establishment_register_key is the superseded working name.
The same concept on two registers is not a join.
Census CBP ESTAB is a count and a false friend. It belongs to jurisdiction_activity_aggregate.

concepts.definition: An industry code and its title attached to a register row.
notes: Keep apart from zoning_district and assessment_property_class.

concepts.definition: A published employment range for a register row.
notes: Published input to the illustrative reading employment_interval. Jurisdiction-wide counts belong to jurisdiction_activity_aggregate.

concepts.definition: A regulator's or licensing body's register of facilities or licences, with the facts in it.
notes: Facets by authority_scale. Federal facility registers stay on activity_registers.

concepts.definition: Counts or statistics for a whole jurisdiction. Not a claim about any spine unit.
notes: Parcel-level refusal for this object is not_in_coverage.
Attaches to a jurisdiction through statistical_geography_code.

concepts.definition: The zone a by-law assigns to land, with its code, label, and category.
notes: Comparability needs the by-law reference beside the code.

concepts.definition: An exception or holding provision attached to a zone.
notes: Rides with the zoning claim. It is not a separate ladder rung.

concepts.definition: A land-use designation from an official plan: policy, not regulation.
The assessor's classification of a property for taxation.
notes: Stamp it as property class. It is not zoning and not NAICS.

concepts.definition: The assessor's building-use code inside a class.
A monetary value on the assessment roll, with facets assessed, land, taxable, and market_estimate.
notes: Those facets are near one another and are not interchangeable in a calculation.

concepts.definition: The roll's year and section. Stamp-adjacent: the year maps to observation_on.
notes: The year maps to the existing stamp field observation_on. This slice does not add stamp fields.

concepts.definition: An overlay or encumbrance a joined source states, named by its authority and never summed. Family parent; the ledger gives it no rows of its own.
notes: Grain is usually zone_polygon. Some source layers are polylines or points and need a stated distance or side rule.
A missing overlay is not_joined or not_in_coverage.

concepts.definition: Flood hazard overlay named by its authority, including FEMA NFHL zones, NPCA regulation and floodplain layers, and the Haldimand Flood Hazard Limit.
notes: Haldimand's flood hazard limit is a polyline and needs a stated distance or side rule.

concepts.definition: Natural heritage overlay named by its authority, including Niagara NES series, NHS, wetlands, and woodlands.
Heritage designation overlay named by its authority, including designated heritage properties and parcels.
notes: Niagara's designated heritage properties are points. Welland's designated heritage parcels are polygons. Points need a stated distance or side rule.

concepts.definition: A planning-policy overlay that restricts or shapes what is permitted, named by its authority. Includes PSEZ, growth-boundary flags, NY BOA, and brownfield community-improvement plans.
notes: Morgen locked this band as constraints on 2026-09-25.

concepts.definition: A published building floor area, in the source's unit.
notes: Published input on the stamp of a reading. Not a raw field copied onto the derived_readings rung.
The illustrative reading identifier floor_area_m2 already exists in the PCDP vocabulary.

concepts.definition: A published parcel or lot area, assessor-stated or geometry-computed.
notes: Published input on the stamp of a reading. Not a raw field copied onto the derived_readings rung.
lot_area_m2 as a named reading is deferred and is not in the PCDP reading list.

concepts.definition: Owner name and mailing fields on an assessment record.
notes: D-13: retain at ingest and decide the presentation tier later. PCDP v1 has no owner rung.
NPCA owner values were not sampled. Licence clearance is deferred.

concepts.definition: A non-identifying owner-type code.
notes: PCDP v1 has no owner rung.

ledger_provenance.note: Counts are the ledger at encode time. evidence_level stays the closed set of four, including the two values whose count is zero.

items.reason: Planning file 10 §1 and §7 item 2 recommend ca, us, and neutral defaults. Morgen has not confirmed them. They are not a closed product rule in this catalog.
Planning file 10 §6 proposes lot_area_m2 as a reading fed by lot_area_published. It is not added to the PCDP illustrative reading list.

Planning file 12 §2 proposes concept_id, native field and value, ledger_id, facet, authority, authority_scale on the stamp, claim_grain and register_family on the claim, edition_label, access_tier, is_register_quotation, and display_label_key. The enums are closed here. The fields are not added to the source stamp or to fixtures.
Planning file 12 §3 proposes a per-source sentinel map in the normalize step. Sentinels are not encoded as claim fields here.
fixtures/parcels/ and PR #13 are unchanged, including the Erie floor-area note.
Planning file 12 §4. MPAC assessment data stays not_licensed. NPCA parcel layers are not ingested. Owner values stay unread.
Planning file 12 §5. history and servicing still need a band decision. No MCS cell is changed and no dataset_id is edited.
